notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and intake in progress. 152 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), three of Chapter Five's five per-Grace Charm trees in full -- the 14-Charm Heart Grace tree (Nirguna), the 12-Charm Staff Grace tree (Nirvikalpa), and the 48-Charm Cup Grace tree (Dharma) -- and four of five named sub-sections of a fourth: the Ring Grace tree's (Nirvishesha) Ring Combat Charms (16 Charms), All-Consuming God-Monster Style (6 Charms), Body-Strengthening Charms (5 Charms), Creation-Based Crafting (3 Charms), and the first Glamour Charms tree (14 Charms). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. The Ring tree's 'Greater Arts of Glamour' sub-section, the Sword Grace Charm tree, the universal Assumption-type Charm tree, Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths, an apparent unreviewed sixth 'Way' Grace, and Chapter One/Two/Six/Seven's setting, Mountain Folk and Storytelling material are not yet inventoried. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
